use_case: Predictive maintenance for well equipment: vendor add-on that analyzes pump-off controller data (dynamometer cards, motor load, run time) to predict rod pump failures up to 2 weeks ahead and suggest idle-time settings
vendor_or_model: SCADA vendor's cloud analytics add-on (machine learning models trained by the vendor across its customers' wells), fed by the SYS-08 connector
data_categories: Pump-off controller data and alarms from 8 pilot wells; well names and locations; no personal information
consequential_decision_category: None (equipment); escalates to Safety/CI if outputs ever change controller settings or defer safety-critical inspections, and to Employment if used to evaluate staff
human_in_the_loop: Owner or Field Superintendent reviews every alert and decides whether to call the pulling unit; write-back to controllers turned off 2026-08-26 and checked monthly
applicable_laws: No sector AI rule; FTC Act Section 5 applies only to the company's own claims about the tool; subscription terms (data use, change notice) not yet negotiated; Fla. Stat. 501.171 not triggered because no personal information is used
status: Pilot (8 wells, advisory only); continued under conditions approved 2026-08-31
